Fleet maintenance without the guesswork

Plan servicing around the vehicles, their records and the next run. Discuss heavy diesel maintenance for your transport fleet directly with Clive.

Call Clive · 0474 372 852

Put priorities in order

Start with the number of trucks, their makes and models, and the work already due. Service history, kilometres, engine hours and known issues help identify what needs discussing first.

Share your preferred dates and operational limits. Availability, the number of vehicles that can be handled and the proposed schedule are confirmed directly with Clive.

Information for a useful maintenance discussion

  • A vehicle list and available service records.
  • Known faults or recurring issues for each truck.
  • Location and workshop or yard access.
  • Dates when each vehicle can be taken off the road.
  • Who can approve work and receive job updates.

Planned work and new faults

Scheduled maintenance and an unexpected fault may need different arrangements. Mention any truck that has stopped, is due for an important run or needs an assessment before returning to work.

See truck servicing for routine maintenance enquiries and transmission repairs for shifting or drive concerns.

A direct conversation

You speak with Clive rather than submitting a fleet enquiry into an online queue. Discuss the scope, access, timing and charges before a booking is confirmed. Travel arrangements are made for the actual Victorian location.
